content: He passes through the crowd and climbs the ship's bow. He sees the towering skeletons just ahead of La Conquista.

raw: The Skeletal Reef: a labyrinth of bones, the pulsing heart of the Salt Flat, a realm of death where no mortal dares tread. Yet, La Conquista sails toward its valleys, dauntlessly, recklessly.
content: The Skeletal Reef: a labyrinth of bones, the pulsing heart of the Salt Flat, a realm of death where no mortal dares tread. Yet, La Conquista sails toward its valleys, dauntlessly, recklessly.

raw: Despite the constant bumps and jolts, Isidro's eyes remain fixed on the Corazonix floating at the center of the transmutation table.
content: Despite the constant bumps and jolts, Isidro's eyes remain fixed on the Corazonix floating at the center of the transmutation table.

raw: Layers of Arts energy fields have separated it. The insides glow with a metallic gleam.
content: Layers of Arts energy fields have separated it. The insides glow with a metallic gleam.

raw: Even the slightest motion is reflected upon its surface through the needle of the probe.
content: Even the slightest motion is reflected upon its surface through the needle of the probe.

raw: [name="Isidro"]The rusted alloy has been successfully isolated. The newly added alloy has been successfully integrated.
speaker: Isidro
content: The rusted alloy has been successfully isolated. The newly added alloy has been successfully integrated.

raw: [name="Isidro"]Now, for the last step, to etch a new Originium circuit inside the Corazonix... I can't afford to make a single mistake.
speaker: Isidro
content: Now, for the last step, to etch a new Originium circuit inside the Corazonix... I can't afford to make a single mistake.

raw: [name="Isidro"]There is no time to test the effects of the circuit. We have only one chance.
speaker: Isidro
content: There is no time to test the effects of the circuit. We have only one chance.

speaker: Isidro
content: Steady, steady...

raw: Another jolt sends the dismantled compass components on the table spilling onto the ground.
content: Another jolt sends the dismantled compass components on the table spilling onto the ground.

raw: With one hand holding the probe, Isidro draws his sword with the other and stabs the cabin wall with it to steady himself.
content: With one hand holding the probe, Isidro draws his sword with the other and stabs the cabin wall with it to steady himself.

raw: [name="Isidro"]El Dominio del Mar... If the pirates can fight in the wind and waves with this technique, then I can use it to steady myself amidst this turbulence!
speaker: Isidro
content: El Dominio del Mar... If the pirates can fight in the wind and waves with this technique, then I can use it to steady myself amidst this turbulence!

raw: With each tilt of the ship, Isidro counters with a thrust of his sword. Soon, the cabin is in chaos—a pot covers one of his feet, while a piece of canvas wraps around his leg.
content: With each tilt of the ship, Isidro counters with a thrust of his sword. Soon, the cabin is in chaos—a pot covers one of his feet, while a piece of canvas wraps around his leg.

raw: He pays no heed to them. The only thing he sees is the trail of liquid Originium drawn by the needle of his probe.
content: He pays no heed to them. The only thing he sees is the trail of liquid Originium drawn by the needle of his probe.

speaker: Isidro
content: Almost there...

raw: Sweat runs down his cheeks and into his mouth. He feels control slipping from the hand holding the probe as his strained muscles verge on spasming.
content: Sweat runs down his cheeks and into his mouth. He feels control slipping from the hand holding the probe as his strained muscles verge on spasming.

speaker: Isidro
content: I did it! I did it!

raw: [name="Isidro"]Now, all that's left is to insert the shaped Corazonix back into the shell of the compass...
speaker: Isidro
content: Now, all that's left is to insert the shaped Corazonix back into the shell of the compass...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Isidro
content: —Argh!

raw: Isidro forces his eyelids open through the blood and salt, and sees the Arts field beginning to go out of control under some kind of powerful Arts interference.
content: Isidro forces his eyelids open through the blood and salt, and sees the Arts field beginning to go out of control under some kind of powerful Arts interference.

raw: His probe lies on the other side of the cabin, the needle broken into several pieces. The components of the compass are nowhere to be seen, except for the outer shell.
content: His probe lies on the other side of the cabin, the needle broken into several pieces. The components of the compass are nowhere to be seen, except for the outer shell.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
Under the pressure of the overloaded Arts field, the newly-formed Corazonix begins to tremble violently.
content: Under the pressure of the overloaded Arts field, the newly-formed Corazonix begins to tremble violently.

speaker: Elysium
content: Thorns! Thorns!

raw: [name="Pascuala"]What did that finshit Anastasio just do?!
speaker: Pascuala
content: What did that finshit Anastasio just do?!

raw: [name="Weedy"]*cough* An Inquisition handcannon. He fired it into the cabin!
speaker: Weedy
content: *cough* An Inquisition handcannon. He fired it into the cabin!

raw: [name="Juana"]Stay away from the alchemical equipment! It's out of control because of interference from the handcannon's Arts energy!
speaker: Juana
content: Stay away from the alchemical equipment! It's out of control because of interference from the handcannon's Arts energy!

raw: [name="Elysium"]What are you doing here, Señora Juana? Who has the helm?
speaker: Elysium
content: What are you doing here, Señora Juana? Who has the helm?

speaker: Juana
content: Don't worry, it's in good hands.

speaker: Pascuala
content: Teach! Where's Teach?!

raw: [name="Weedy"]She's over here! She's got a piece of broken wood stuck in her leg!
speaker: Weedy
content: She's over here! She's got a piece of broken wood stuck in her leg!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Pascuala"]Damn it... damn it! I can't stop the bleeding!
speaker: Pascuala
content: Damn it... damn it! I can't stop the bleeding!

speaker: Elysium
content: Thorns! Thorns! Say something!

raw: Isidro opens his mouth, but his tongue does not obey. He forces himself to sit up. There is no time to think about how many ribs he broke.
content: Isidro opens his mouth, but his tongue does not obey. He forces himself to sit up. There is no time to think about how many ribs he broke.

raw: On the transmutation table, the Corazonix starts to bubble as if it's boiling.
content: On the transmutation table, the Corazonix starts to bubble as if it's boiling.

raw: One moment of hesitation, and the last Corazonix of Iberia, their only hope for survival—
content: One moment of hesitation, and the last Corazonix of Iberia, their only hope for survival—
Will turn to dust.
He must retrieve it!

raw: Isidro looks around desperately, but sees none of the compass's components, not even a working tool.
content: Isidro looks around desperately, but sees none of the compass's components, not even a working tool.

speaker: Isidro
content: No... no...

raw: Isidro stumbles to his feet. He cannot feel his left arm, but can still move his right arm.
content: Isidro stumbles to his feet. He cannot feel his left arm, but can still move his right arm.

raw: He runs towards the transmutation table.
content: He runs towards the transmutation table.

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=100, yFrom=-50, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.1, yScaleFrom=1.1, xScaleTo=0.85, yScaleTo=0.85, duration=10, block=false)]
The resistance from the Arts field is much stronger than expected. It feels like putting his hand into boiling magma.
content: The resistance from the Arts field is much stronger than expected. It feels like putting his hand into boiling magma.

raw: His glove offers no protection against the rampaging Arts energy. Isidro quivers as the energy corrodes his arm.
content: His glove offers no protection against the rampaging Arts energy. Isidro quivers as the energy corrodes his arm.

speaker: Elysium
content: What are you doing, Thorns?!

speaker: Isidro
content: This is my Corazonix.

speaker: Isidro
content: ...MY compass!

raw: The Corazonix dances in his palm, as though it has gained life.
content: The Corazonix dances in his palm, as though it has gained life.

raw: It flows through every gash and hole the Arts energy left upon his arm.
content: It flows through every gash and hole the Arts energy left upon his arm.

raw: Isidro has gazed upon this substance so many times, seeking a connection with it.
content: Isidro has gazed upon this substance so many times, seeking a connection with it.

raw: But now, in this very moment, he understands that it has become one with his flesh.
content: But now, in this very moment, he understands that it has become one with his flesh.

content: ...Argh—!!
